references.title: Dripping Slime VFX for the Unity game engine
references.creator: RealtimeVFXStore
references.review: Played in browser; long narrowing strands and thick end beads informed the attached ooze. No external asset downloaded or reused.

jump: One ballistic launch, distinct apex and falling door contact under native Ammo gravity. Authored rise, compact apex and fall poses follow vertical speed.
adhesive: Native animated morphs over a 20-second clip. Upper attachment pinned; slow sag, thick beads and connected strands. Low impacts stop before crossing the floor; glue lifetime and clearing unchanged.
representation: Authored adhesive presentation, not a free-surface fluid simulation; Ammo owns movement, leaf collision and contact.

checks.visualReview: Reviewed recorded jump phases from three angles, continuous ooze at 4/9/12/14/17 seconds, floor-safe low splat and open-door recovery.

montage: Side hop (4.5 s), uninterrupted front hop and ooze (about 19 s), rear hop (4.5 s). Full individual recordings retained.
